<design_brief>
## Design Concept
This pitch deck positions XYN Trader as a technically rigorous, institutional-grade fintech product. Driven by the user's explicit style request, the visual posture borrows from modern professional trading terminals (like Bloomberg or high-end institutional dashboards) combined with the structural precision of the Swiss International Style—prioritizing sharp grids, ample negative space, and typographic alignment to project technical solidity and trust. 

The color story explicitly rejects the neon-blue fintech cliche. Instead, it anchors on a deep, ultra-dark background (`#10120F`) to minimize glare and simulate a pro-trader environment. Pure white text (`#FFFFFF`) is mandatory here to ensure razor-sharp legibility against the near-black canvas, supported by a slate gray for secondary information. The palette uses highly specific, semantic status accents: Lime Green for success/activation, Amber for waiting/status, and Red for risk. The typographic voice relies entirely on Inter—a neo-grotesque sans-serif that renders Cyrillic beautifully, delivering the requested clean lines and mechanical precision.

## Visual Language
- **Imagery**: Supporting and strictly literal. Use *only* the provided application screenshots from `outputs/`. No lifestyle photography, abstract AI art, or generic stock images. Screenshots should be displayed flat with sharp edges, free of stylized 3D tilts or heavy drop shadows. 
- **Containers**: Mixed approach prioritizing whitespace. Text sits directly on the background where possible. When grouping complex metrics or rules, use sharp-cornered (0px radius) solid surface cards (`#1E211D`) with a subtle 1px border (`#2F332C`). 
- **Icons**: Sharp, geometric, solid-fill icons (Font Awesome). Use strictly for structural wayfinding (e.g., status indicators, architecture nodes) and color-code them according to the semantic palette.
- **Dataviz**: Minimalist and flat. Chart grids should use the `#2F332C` border color. Data series utilize `#B6E36B` (positive/primary metric), `#E9BD6C` (secondary/baseline), and `#EE827B` (risk/drawdown).
- **Motif**: A crisp, 2px thick "signal line" in Lime Green (`#B6E36B`), exactly 40px wide, positioned flush-left directly above every page's main heading, acting as a visual anchor of activation and precision.

## Layout Directives
- **Global**: 60px margins on all sides. Left-align all typography to enforce a strict vertical axis. Place a discreet slide number in the bottom right corner in `#8B9389`.
- **Cover**: Minimalist and commanding. The title and subtitle sit centrally on the left, with the primary dashboard screenshot anchoring the right. 
- **Table of Contents**: Not applicable to this outline.
- **Section Dividers**: Not explicitly requested in outline, but if used, massive typography on an otherwise empty dark canvas.
- **Closing**: Echo the cover's exact layout, replacing the subtitle with contact information and next steps.

**Slide map**

| id | pattern | image | image layout | density |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cover | title alongside hero dashboard view | hero | split-major@right | low |
| thesis | stark text defining the strategic shift | none | none | medium |
| problem | bulleted list of workflow failures | none | none | medium |
| solution_product | focused title above full dashboard proof | hero | center-stage | low |
| workflow_screens | four distinct pillars with accompanying screen components | supporting | grid-4 | medium |
| engine_logic | logic steps text alongside rule generator UI | supporting | split-major@right | medium |
| learning_cycle_governance | governance points beside learning metrics view | supporting | inset@right | medium |
| architecture_stack | structural diagram/text with side anchor | supporting | strip-side@left | high |
| scope_trust | dense security points next to risk UI | supporting | inset-narrow@right | high |
| roadmap_next_steps | timeline strip above detailed phase goals | supporting | strip-top | high |

## Design Tokens

| token | hex | usage |
|---|---|---|
| primary | #B6E36B | Lime Green for primary accents, success states, and the motif |
| bg-canvas | #10120F | Ultra-dark background for all slides |
| bg-surface | #1E211D | Slightly elevated dark tone for data cards and architectural bounding boxes |
| text-main | #FFFFFF | Pure white for maximum contrast and legibility of primary text on dark canvas |
| text-muted | #8B9389 | Cool gray for captions, secondary bullets, and metadata |
| border-subtle | #2F332C | Dark gray for table borders, grid lines, and sharp card edges |
| status-wait | #E9BD6C | Amber for pending statuses, secondary chart lines, and neutral alerts |
| status-risk | #EE827B | Red for risk metrics, stale data warnings, and system guardrails |

| role | family | size (px) | applies_to |
|---|---|---|---|
| display | Inter | 48 | Cover title, major metrics |
| heading | Inter | 32 | Slide titles |
| body | Inter | 18 | Main bullet points, paragraph text |
| caption | Inter | 14 | Source notes, UI labels, slide numbers |

## Guardrails
- **Forbidden**: Rounded corners on any container or image (destroys technical rigor).
- **Forbidden**: Glowing drop-shadows or neon gradients (violates the flat, clean fintech mandate).
- **Forbidden**: Abstract or decorative imagery (detracts from the real product screenshots).
- **Forbidden**: Center-aligned body text (breaks the structural grid).

## Image frames
Resolved by the slides add-on from the Slide map's image layout column — canvas 1280×720 px, x, y = top-left corner. Generate one image per frame with exactly the listed aspect_ratio and place each image in its own frame (cover-fit); never reuse one image for several frames. Text boxes are where the layout expects the page text. Overlay rows put text on the image: ask the image prompt to keep that text box calm and the subject elsewhere, then look at the generated image before writing the page and move the text block to where the image is actually quiet.

| id | layout | image frame(s): x, y, w×h → aspect_ratio | text box(es): x, y, width |
|---|---|---|---|
| cover | split-major@right | 384, 0, 896×720 → 5:4 | 60, 210, 274 wide (6 lines) |
| solution_product | center-stage | 208, 124, 864×486 → 16:9 | 380, 56, 520 wide (title); 290, 618, 700 wide (2 lines) |
| workflow_screens | grid-4@right | 480, 120, 360×260 → 4:3; 860, 120, 360×260 → 4:3; 480, 400, 360×260 → 4:3; 860, 400, 360×260 → 4:3 | 60, 120, 380 wide (9 lines) |
| engine_logic | split-major@right | 384, 0, 896×720 → 5:4 | 60, 210, 274 wide (6 lines) |
| learning_cycle_governance | inset@right | 748, 65, 472×590 → 4:5 | 60, 120, 600 wide (9 lines) |
| architecture_stack | strip-side@left | 0, 0, 180×720 → 1:4 | 240, 60, 900 wide (title) |
| scope_trust | inset-narrow@right | 880, 150, 340×510 → 2:3 | 60, 60, 1160 wide (title); 60, 150, 780 wide (13 lines) |
| roadmap_next_steps | strip-top | 0, 0, 1280×320 → 4:1 | 60, 352, 700 wide (title); 840, 430, 380 wide (4 lines) |

## Color contrast
Checked by the slides add-on against the Colors table (WCAG contrast: text under 24 px — under 19 px at font-weight 700+ — needs 4.5:1; larger text and meaningful graphics need 3:1).
Text under 24 px uses only colors whose row says "any text" or the listed smaller-text variant (the -text rows added to the Colors table); card titles, subheads and labels under 24 px count as smaller text unless their font-weight is 700+. Keep the original accent hex for fills, lines, charts and large numerals.

| token | hex | lowest contrast on the deck's backgrounds | text use |
|---|---|---|---|
| primary | #B6E36B | 10.99:1 on bg-surface | any text |
| text-main | #FFFFFF | 16.27:1 on bg-surface | any text |
| text-muted | #8B9389 | 5.13:1 on bg-surface | any text |
| status-wait | #E9BD6C | 9.26:1 on bg-surface | any text |
| status-risk | #EE827B | 6.28:1 on bg-surface | any text |
</design_brief>
